# Oxylabs Documentation

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://developers.oxylabs.io/introduction.md): Find everything you need to use Oxylabs’ products effectively, from detailed product documentation to additional resources like the help center, changelog, and more.
- [Changelog](https://developers.oxylabs.io/changelog.md): Track the latest Oxylabs product updates, feature releases, and improvements. Stay informed on what's new with our tools and documentation.
- [Quick Start: Web API](https://developers.oxylabs.io/get-started/quick-start-web-api.md): Get from an API key to your first Oxylabs Web API search and scrape in just five minutes.
- [Quick Start: Proxies](https://developers.oxylabs.io/get-started/quick-start-proxies.md): Start using Oxylabs proxies in just a few minutes with a simple step-by-step guide.
- [Quick Start: Web Unblocker](https://developers.oxylabs.io/get-started/quick-start-web-unblocker.md): Start using Oxylabs Web Unblocker in just a few minutes with a simple step-by-step guide.
- [Quick Start: Agent Browser](https://developers.oxylabs.io/get-started/quick-start-agent-browser.md): Start using Oxylabs Agent Browser in just a few minutes with a simple step-by-step guide.
- [Overview](https://developers.oxylabs.io/dashboard/overview.md): Oxylabs Dashboard is where you activate products, monitor spending, and manage your account. All in one place to set up and manage as you like.
- [Product Instances](https://developers.oxylabs.io/dashboard/product-instances.md): Learn how to create, configure, and manage product instances in the Oxylabs Dashboard.
- [Credit-Based Billing](https://developers.oxylabs.io/dashboard/credit-based-billing.md): Understand how the Oxylabs Dashboard's shared credit balance works across all your products.
- [Upgrading, Downgrading, Top-Ups](https://developers.oxylabs.io/dashboard/upgrading-downgrading-top-ups.md): Learn how to change your plan or add credits without changing your recurring commitment, and when to choose one over the other.
- [Payments & Invoices](https://developers.oxylabs.io/dashboard/payments-and-invoices.md): Manage your payment methods and billing details, and learn more about invoices and subscription cancellations.
- [Team & Account Settings](https://developers.oxylabs.io/dashboard/team-and-account-settings.md): Manage your team members, account settings, and notification preferences in the Oxylabs Dashboard.
- [Managing IP Products](https://developers.oxylabs.io/dashboard/managing-ip-products.md): Learn how to manage your IPs, understand per-IP billing, and see what happens to your proxy list when your plan changes.
- [Dashboard API](https://developers.oxylabs.io/dashboard/dashboard-api.md): Programmatic access to Oxylabs product users for tracking usage statistics with the Dashboard API.
- [Have a Question?](https://developers.oxylabs.io/have-a-question.md): Discover the ways to contact Oxylabs 24/7 support team.

## Products

- [All Oxylabs Products](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/overview.md): Discover Oxylabs products, their functions, features and how to use them effectively
- [Web API](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api.md): Learn how to use and integrate Oxylabs Web API – an all-in-one REST API for web search and page data collection.
- [Authentication](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api/authentication.md): Learn how to authenticate requests to Oxylabs Web API endpoints.
- [/search](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api/search.md): Learn how to use Oxylabs Web API /search endpoint to search the live web and collect ranked results.
- [/scrape](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api/scrape.md): Learn how to use Oxylabs Web API /scrape endpoint to fetch and parse any web page in the format you want.
- [Dedicated Scrapers](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api/scrape/dedicated-scrapers.md): Discover Oxylabs Web API dedicated scrapers for structured field extraction from specialized web targets.
- [Endpoint Discovery](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api/scrape/endpoint-discovery.md): Discover all up-to-date Web API scrape endpoints and their parameters at runtime instead of hardcoding a list.
- [Delivery Modes](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api/scrape/delivery-modes.md): Discover how Web API delivers results: realtime responses, async jobs with polling or callbacks, cloud storage delivery, and batch requests.
- [AI Parsing](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api/scrape/ai-parsing.md): Extract structured JSON from any page in one Web API request, using a natural-language prompt or a JSON Schema definition.
- [Troubleshooting](https://developers.oxylabs.io/products/web-api/troubleshooting.md): Web API status codes, error response formats, retry policy, and common troubleshooting solutions.

## API Reference

- [Overview](https://developers.oxylabs.io/api-reference/overview.md): Base URL, authentication, request conventions, delivery modes, and response envelope shapes for the Web API.

- [Jobs & Discovery](https://developers.oxylabs.io/api-reference/jobs-and-discovery.md): Reference for submitting, batching, and collecting async scrape jobs, and for listing endpoints and parameters at runtime.
- [Full Endpoint Index](https://developers.oxylabs.io/api-reference/full-endpoint-index.md): A searchable index of all Web API scrape endpoints, supported delivery modes, and target-specific parameters.
- [Errors & Status Codes](https://developers.oxylabs.io/api-reference/errors-and-status-codes.md): Technical specification for HTTP status codes, RFC 9457 problem documents, error classification, and production retry logic for the Oxylabs Web API.
- [Search Engine Scrapers](https://developers.oxylabs.io/api-reference/dedicated-scrapers/search-engine-scrapers.md): Reference for Web API's Google and Bing scraper endpoints: parameters and delivery modes for every endpoint.
- [Commerce Scrapers](https://developers.oxylabs.io/api-reference/dedicated-scrapers/commerce-scrapers.md): Reference for Web API commerce scraper endpoints: Amazon, Walmart, Target, the Kroger banners, and more. Parameters and delivery modes for every endpoint.
- [LLM & AI Scrapers](https://developers.oxylabs.io/api-reference/dedicated-scrapers/llm-and-ai-scrapers.md): Reference for Web API's ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity scraper endpoints. Async-only, with parameters and response fields.
- [Media Scrapers](https://developers.oxylabs.io/api-reference/dedicated-scrapers/media-scrapers.md): Reference for dedicated Web API media scraper endpoints, parameters and delivery modes for every endpoint.

- [Which Oxylabs products can I use if I need large-volumes of video data for AI model training?](https://developers.oxylabs.io/help-center/data-for-llms/which-oxylabs-products-can-i-use-if-i-need-large-volumes-of-video-data-for-ai-model-training.md): Find out which Oxylabs solutions are best at collecting video data for AI training.
- [Which video data solution should I pick for my specific use case?](https://developers.oxylabs.io/help-center/data-for-llms/which-video-data-solution-should-i-pick-for-my-specific-use-case.md): Learn how to choose the right video data solution for your specific needs.
- [How do I make sure the data in YouTube Datasets is high-quality and reliable?](https://developers.oxylabs.io/help-center/data-for-llms/how-do-i-make-sure-the-data-in-youtube-datasets-is-high-quality-and-reliable.md): Learn about compliance standards and ethical sourcing processes for the quality and reliability of YouTube Datasets.

# Agent Instructions
This documentation is published with GitBook. GitBook is the documentation platform designed so that both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over technical content effectively. Learn more at gitbook.com.

## Querying This Documentation
This site has an agentic ask interface you may use to query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.

Perform an HTTP GET request on the following URL with the `ask` and `goal` query parameters:

```
GET https://developers.oxylabs.io/index.md?ask=<question>&goal=<user_goal>
```

`ask` is the immediate question: it should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
`goal` is what the user is ultimately trying to achieve, the reason they need the answer. Sharing it helps GitBook give you a better, more relevant answer. A goal is most helpful when it describes the outcome the user wants rather than restating the question. For example, with `ask=how do I create an API token`, a goal like `automate deployments from our CI pipeline` lets GitBook tailor the answer to that use case.

The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
